items.quote: Ten samples, namely 1-4#, 14# and 16-20#, were selected to be tested on the NETZSCH STA 449C DSC equipment.

The annealed microstructure was observed on the FEI Quanta-200 SEM and the compositions of constituent phases were analyzed by EDX, with an accelerating voltage of 20 kV and a beam spot of 5.0 or 6.0 Å.
Using the Cu Ka radiation, the XRD experiments were carried out on the D/Max2500DC equipment.
Since Sc is volatile, the composition of each sample was measured by energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX), as is also given in Table 1.
They were heated from room temperature to 1400 °C at a rate of 10 K/min and then cooled to 200 °C at the same rate, except that the 1-3# samples were heated to 1300 °C.
